source: OMG DMN 1.3 (formal/2021-02-01), as modelled by @bpmnkit/core's dmn-model.ts and parser and evaluated by @bpmnkit/engine

traits.name: drgElement
traits.description: Top-level element of the decision requirements graph that the parser reads into its own model list: decision, input data, knowledge source and business knowledge model.

traits.name: requirement
traits.description: Edge of the DRD held by its target element; its single child references the source by `href`.

traits.name: artifact
traits.description: Top-level element that annotates the graph rather than taking part in it.

elements.name: dmnElement
elements.description: Root of the DMN type hierarchy: anything may carry an id, a description and extension elements.

elements.name: definitions
elements.description: Document root; holds the DRG elements, artifacts and the diagram.

elements.name: decision
elements.description: Determines an output from inputs, with a decision table or a literal expression. Its result is in scope for the decisions that require it under its name.

elements.name: inputData
elements.description: External data a decision reads.

elements.name: knowledgeSource
elements.description: Authority behind a decision or business knowledge model.

elements.name: businessKnowledgeModel
elements.description: Reusable decision logic invoked by decisions.

elements.name: informationRequirement
elements.description: A decision's dependency on another decision's result or on input data.

elements.name: knowledgeRequirement
elements.description: An invocation of a business knowledge model.

elements.name: authorityRequirement
elements.description: A dependency on a knowledge source, decision or input data as authority.

elements.name: requiredDecision
elements.description: Reference to a decision.

elements.name: requiredInput
elements.description: Reference to input data.

elements.name: requiredKnowledge
elements.description: Reference to a business knowledge model.

elements.name: requiredAuthority
elements.description: Reference to a knowledge source.

elements.name: decisionTable
elements.description: Rules over input columns; the hit policy decides which matching rules make the result.

attributes.name: aggregation
attributes.description: Only with hit policy COLLECT: combine the matching rules' first outputs.

elements.name: input
elements.description: Input column; its expression is evaluated once per evaluation.

elements.name: inputExpression
elements.description: The FEEL expression whose value the column's input entries test.

attributes.name: typeRef
attributes.description: FEEL type name, e.g. `string`, `number`, `date`; free text in the model.

elements.name: output
elements.description: Output column; a rule's output entry gives its value, keyed by `name` (then `label`, then `id`).

attributes.name: typeRef
attributes.description: FEEL type name, e.g. `string`, `number`, `date`; free text in the model.

elements.name: rule
elements.description: One row: input entries (unary tests) and output entries (expressions), one per column.

elements.name: inputEntry
elements.description: FEEL unary tests; empty or `-` matches anything.

elements.name: outputEntry
elements.description: FEEL expression giving the column's value.

elements.name: literalExpression
elements.description: A FEEL expression as a decision's logic.

attributes.name: typeRef
attributes.description: FEEL type name, e.g. `string`, `number`, `date`; free text in the model.

elements.name: text
elements.description: Text content of an expression or annotation.

elements.name: description
elements.description: Free-form documentation.

elements.name: extensionElements
elements.description: Vendor extensions; the parser also keeps a decision's unmodelled children (such as `literalExpression`) here.

elements.name: textAnnotation
elements.description: Free-form comment on the diagram.

elements.name: association
elements.description: Links two elements, usually a text annotation to what it annotates.
